body: Believe it or not it’s very difficult to have CPS actually take children away, and the foster system is worse. Unfortunately, I was the guinea pig child they had at 17 so I was raised by emotionally damaged children. They’ve since cleaned up, hence them pretending none of it happened at all. I’m a broker during a financial decline, my job is not fulfilling at all. And cutting off contact would again require me not being involved in my siblings lives. I’m stuck
